jobs.title: AVP, Product Marketing — Independent Distribution
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Global Atlantic is seeking a strategic, highly collaborative, and results-oriented marketing leader to define and execute product marketing for Independent Distribution, including Independent Marketing Organizations (IMOs) and Brokerage General Agencies (BGAs). Reporting to the Principal, Product Marketing, the AVP will lead content creation activities related to the development, stand up and launch of annuity products targeted to the Independent Marketing and Independent Broker/Dealer distribution channels.

The successful candidate will combine solid independent distribution background with insight, disciplined execution, analytical rigor, and annuity product knowledge while partnering across Sales, National Accounts, Product, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, Creative, and Analytics.

Ideal Experience

The ideal candidate has demonstrated experience marketing annuity solutions through independent distribution. They connect sales strategy, audience insight, and execution; simplify complex products; influence senior stakeholders; lead teams; and move cross-functional initiatives from concept through measurable results.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Define and lead the product marketing strategy for Independent Distribution, aligning priorities, resources, and execution with sales objectives and enterprise brand standards.

- Develop and manage marketing plans that translate business priorities into integrated campaigns, channel programs, sales enablement, and measurable outcomes.

- Partner with Independent Sales and National Accounts leadership to identify audience needs, shape creative marketing approaches, and strengthen engagement with IMO and BGA partners.

- Lead strategy and execution for new product launches, including positioning, messaging, launch plans, sales tools, collateral, and financial professional communications.

- Direct the development of digital and print marketing materials, websites, and related resources in partnership with Marketing and Creative teams.

- Manage initiatives end to end, from brief development and stakeholder alignment through review, approval, deployment, measurement, and optimization.

- Partner closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to ensure marketing and advertising materials are accurate, on brand, and approved for use in accordance with applicable requirements.

- Partner with the marketing analytics workstream by defining reporting, success metrics, and scorecards; use performance insights to improve engagement, reach, and contribution to revenue.

- Build strong relationships across the organization and influence effectively in a matrixed environment.

QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field.

- 7-10 years of related experience, including experience in the sales and marketing of annuity products.

- Experience supporting Independent Distribution, including IMO and BGA relationships.

- FINRA Series 6 registration, or the ability to obtain it within six months of hire.

- Demonstrated experience developing marketing campaigns, launching products, and managing portfolios of marketing materials, websites, and related resources.

- Demonstrated ability to understand complex products, sales concepts, and strategies and translate them into clear, high-impact messaging and visuals.

Critical Competencies for Success

- Strategic and commercial orientation: Connects marketing priorities to sales goals, audience needs, and measurable business outcomes.

- Collaboration and influence: Builds trusted relationships and works effectively across functions and levels, including with senior stakeholders.

- Ownership and execution: Takes accountability, follows through, and delivers high-quality work from concept through completion.

- Project management and prioritization: Manages multiple workstreams, competing priorities, and tight deadlines with strong organization and attention to detail.

- Competitor and market intelligence: Monitors competitor activity, market trends, distribution dynamics, and audience needs to generate insights that inform positioning, messaging, and go-to-market decisions.

- Attention to detail: Produces accurate, polished, and compliant work by carefully reviewing content, data, and deliverables and ensuring consistency throughout development, approval, and deployment.

- Analytical mindset: Uses data, reporting, and sound judgment to evaluate performance and improve decisions.

- Communication: Demonstrates excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills. Strong writing ability for different mediums – collateral, video, social media, etc.

- Agility and problem solving: Is resourceful, solutions-oriented, professional, and effective in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

- People leadership: Motivates and develops others while fostering accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

Working Conditions and Travel

The role is primarily performed in an office environment using a computer and standard office equipment. Occasional travel may be required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

This is the expected annual base salary range for this Des Moines-based position. Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, and qualification for the role. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, based on factors such as individual and team performance.

Base Salary Range $130,000 - $170,000

To be considered for this role, applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorshi p of an employment Visa at this time .

jobs.title: Principal / Director, Product Origination & Distribution Strategy, Insurance
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

TEAM OVERVIEW

Insurance New Markets & Strategic Partnerships is KKR Insurance’s dedicated team focused on growing the firm’s insurance and reinsurance platform. The team’s mandate is to expand KKR Insurance’s footprint beyond its core relationships and existing platform, including new partnerships, new channels of growth and new products.  The group partners closely with investment teams, commercial team, insurance leadership, and external clients and distribution partners to diversify KKR’s funding sources and grow assets under management across new channels and geographies.

POSITION SUMMARY

KKR is seeking an experienced Principal / Director to join the Insurance New Markets and Strategic Partnerships team and drive the expansion of funding sources with a focus on Defined Contribution. This individual will lead the design, structuring, and go-to-market strategy for guaranteed income within Defined Contribution. Sitting at the intersection of product strategy, structuring, client coverage, and distribution enablement, they will help shape KKR insurance’s long-term growth strategy in this channel.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategy, Development & Client Coverage

- Own the Defined Contribution channel strategy for insurance, building the roadmap for entry and scale and partnering with key leaders across both functions to define, evaluate, and recommend specific growth opportunities for insurance within Defined Contribution

- Lead end-to-end product development and structuring for in-plan or lifetime income solutions designed for distribution through Defined Contribution

- Analyze the competitive landscape, end-participant needs, regulatory developments (SEC, FINRA, state insurance regulators, ERISA), and platform trends to identify product gaps and channel expansion opportunities

- Build and manage strategic relationships with asset managers, record keepers, consultants, trust managers, and other external parties in the KKR ecosystem

- Represent the firm externally as a thought leader on in plan annuities and lifetime income within DC

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Serve as central point of coordination across investment, legal, compliance, distribution, marketing, commercial and client teams for insurance opportunities in Defined Contribution

- Partner closely with public policy & affairs, legal, compliance, and operations to ensure product structures meet fiduciary, regulatory and operational standards

- Monitor channel performance and product uptake, incorporate asset manager or plan sponsor feedback, and drive continuous improvement

QUALIFICATIONS

- 9+ years of experience in asset management, insurance, and/or annuity product distribution, with direct exposure to product development and/or channel strategy at a top-tier asset manager, insurance carrier, or alternative platform. Direct knowledge of the DC ecosystem strongly preferred

- Strong track record designing and launching annuity or retail insurance products, and/or building out new distribution channels (DC, RIA, independent broker-dealer)

- Excellent project management, communication, and stakeholder-coordination skills, partnering effectively with senior leaders across insurance, distribution, commercial, and investment teams

- Strong technical proficiency across insurance, multi-asset solutions, portfolio construction, and annuity/insurance product mechanics

- Comfort leveraging AI tools to accelerate market/competitive analysis, product research, and reporting

- Detailed understanding of products, vehicles, legal and other regulatory, structures, and unique investment requirements of operating insurance strategy in the Defined Contribution space

- Player coach mindset, leading by example

jobs.title: Sports/Secondaries Product Marketing Principal
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

TEAM OVERVIEW

KKR’s Marketing team develops executive content strategies that generate brand and product awareness to engage the firm’s clients with valuable content to meet quantifiable business goals. The team builds deep relationships with clients to bridge the gap between client interests and business goals, to create innovative content strategies. The team is also responsible for consistently investigating trends and best practices to make accurate and tailored recommendations to clients. The Marketing team closely collaborates with the sales, product strategy, and compliance teams.

POSITION DESCRIPTION

The Marketing team is seeking a dynamic and motivated Product Marketing Principal with deep expertise in positioning private equity and primary market secondaries strategies to various client segments including private wealth, family capital, institutional, and insurance. This role will be based in New York and will report to KKR’s Head of Product Marketing. This is a highly collaborative role and strong relationship building, product-related content creation, and project management skills are critical, as this individual will collaborate closely with colleagues in marketing, communications, compliance, product strategy, and investment teams to produce and activate best-in-class marketing materials.

In this role you will thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. You will have extensive knowledge of private equity and secondaries strategies and be curious and enthusiastic about this space.

RESPONSIBILITIES

One dedicated point of contact:

- One dedicated resource to work with KKR Solutions, a newly formed business unit that includes Arctos, a sports investing specialist, Keystone, a GP financing strategy, and a developing private markets secondaries business.

- Responsibilities include: working with KKR Solutions product strategy and investment business teams on all marketing-related matters globally and leading regular meetings with stakeholders to provide updates, confirm priorities and discuss any obstacles/challenges.

Develop & Execute Strategic Marketing Plan:

- Partner with Sales, Product, and Investment team members to create and execute a strategic marketing plan including product-related content & event strategy, campaigns/programs, foundational materials, etc.

- Provide consistent updates on progress, any obstacles, wins, etc.

- Include clearly defined KPI’s and share progress/learnings with key stakeholders.

- Present a Quarterly Business Review to key stakeholders highlighting previous quarter activities and socializing next quarter’s plan.

Creative Idea Generation:

- Be a visionary. Think big and provide creative marketing solutions to capture eyeballs and mindshare in a crowded market.

- Develop compelling programs & campaigns that will capture the attention of clients and prospects, raising the bar with how we attract and engage clients. Drive adoption through targeted campaigns, ongoing education, and end-investor engagement programs.

Sales Enablement:

- Partner with channel marketing to repackage product-related content and create campaigns per sales channel with targeted audiences – wealth, family capital, institutional, etc.

Partner on Strategic Positioning:

- Partner with Product Strategy and Investment teams to define and refine product positioning, value propositions, and messaging frameworks for KKR Solutions offerings across various investor segments (institutional, wealth, family offices).

- Continue to refine based on client feedback and market environment.

- Collaborate with teams to repackage all foundational collateral: FAQ’s, short/longer form pitch decks, main stage presentations, videos, webpage, end investor material, etc.

Manage Compelling & Consistent Content Strategy:

- Lead the product-related content development process collaborating with investment professionals, product strategy, sales, and communications teams to create and launch a steady drumbeat of content to educate, stay top of mind, support client conversations. Focus on relevant, client-centric, differentiated, and actionable product-related content. Develop targeted amplification plan.

- Manage product-related content calendar for team.

- Manage all formats of product-related content - video, short-form content, education, etc.

- Measure and share key learnings/best practices with key stakeholders.

Lead Project Management & Prioritization:

- Serve as project manager for all related marketing projects including stakeholder management, working with compliance, providing consistent updates to stakeholders, etc.

Provide Robust Analytics:

- Track, analyze and socialize engagement analytics and campaign performance with key stakeholders on a consistent basis.

Track Competitor & Market Trends:

- Stay up to date on competitor messaging and marketing tactics. Leverage insights to guide a differentiated approach for KKR.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 10+ years’ experience in asset management marketing at a global Asset Manager or Alternative Investment management firm.

- Direct experience marketing private equity and secondaries strategies

- Skilled in Microsoft Office suite. Experience with Seismic, Asana, Salesforce, and AI-related tools a plus.

- Strong writing ability and familiarity with creating video content.

- Bachelor’s Degree required, CAIA, CFA, or MBA preferred.

jobs.title: Vice President, Marketing Analytics – Content & Product Marketing
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

Position Summary

KKR is seeking a Vice President, Marketing Analytics for Content & Product Marketing to improve the effectiveness, relevance, discoverability, and commercial influence of KKR’s content and product marketing. This individual will serve as the senior analytics partner to the Content Marketing and Product Marketing teams, translating performance data into insights that sharpen content strategy, product positioning, audience engagement, and marketing investment decisions.

The VP will own content and product level performance analysis across thought leadership, webcasts, digital experiences, asset class themes, and product marketing initiatives. The role will connect content engagement to lead generation, sales activity, opportunity progression, product interest, pipeline, and fundraising influence, while partnering with channel analytics leads that own distribution, campaign, funnel, and channel performance.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in marketing analytics, content and digital performance measurement, SEO insights, experimentation, executive reporting, and cross-functional leadership. This role requires a strategic leader who can combine quantitative performance data with qualitative content insights and translate complex findings into clear recommendations for senior marketing and business stakeholders. This candidate should be laser focused on answering the ‘so what’ when in comes to stakeholder performance reports.

Key Responsibilities

- Serve as the primary analytics partner to Content Marketing and Product Marketing teams, defining performance frameworks, KPIs and strategic recommendations aligned to business priorities

- Own content and product level performance analysis across thought leadership, webcasts, asset class themes, product campaigns, landing pages and digital experiences.

- Connect content exposure and engagement to lead generation, sales engagement, opportunity progression, product interest, pipeline and fundraising influence

- Provide insights on thought leadership and webcast performance, including registration, attendance, viewership, engagement, replay activity, and audience follow-up behavior

- Partner with channel-specific marketing analytics leads to understand content distribution performance and contribute to a consolidated view of content, thought leadership, and fundraising influence

- Identify trends across content themes, asset classes, audience segments, formats, topics, and campaigns to inform content planning, product positioning and marketing priorities

- Support monthly and quarterly business reviews with executive ready insights and presentations across asset classes, products, campaigns, audience segments and commercial outcomes

- Conduct keyword, SEO, audience, journey, and competitor content analysis to identify opportunities for improved discoverability, relevance, and growth

- Lead analytics for content testing and optimization, including A/B testing of copy, headlines, calls to action, landing pages, and content formats

- Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for marketing and leadership teams. Ability to find and clearly communicate the story behind the numbers.

- Partner with Marketing Enablement to analyze content usage and engagement in Seismic and provide performance signals that inform content lifecycle, governance and retirement decisions

- Partner with Channel Analytics, Digital, Data & AI Enablement, Technology teams to improve reporting standards, data quality, taxonomy and scalable analytics capabilities

- Mentor and guide junior team members and contribute to building a high-performing analytics team

Experience & Skills

- 10+ years of experience in marketing analytics, content analytics, digital analytics, product marketing analytics, or related analytics roles, preferably in financial services, insurance, asset management, or B2B marketing

- Demonstrated experience serving as senior analytics partner to Content Marketing, Product Marketing, Editorial, or asset class marketing teams

- Deep experience measuring content performance across web, email, CRM, marketing automation, events, webcasts, social, paid media, and sales enablement platforms

- Strong understanding of content strategy, audience engagement, SEO, keyword research, digital journeys, and conversion measurement

- Experience developing executive level reporting and presenting actionable insights to senior marketing and business stakeholders

- Experience building dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar tools

- Experience with web analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, or similar platforms

- Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce, Marketo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar systems

- Proficiency in SQL and experience analyzing data from CRM, marketing, digital, content, and enablement platforms; experience using Python and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake and/or AWS Redshift preferred

- Strong leadership, analytical and stakeholder management skills with ability to influence and drive cross functional action

- Strong communication and presentation skills in communicating performance to marketing peers and stakeholders.

- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, analytics, statistics, business, or a related field.
